result.title: Let the Gallery Learn Itself: Training-Free Iterative Side-View Face Recognition
result.summary: What if a face recognition system could learn from every encounter without a single gradient update? We present Gallery Self-Evolution (GSE), a training-free framework where the gallery itself adapts at test time. The core mechanism---dedup-FIFO curation---archives novel appearance samples after successful recognition while permanently locking the enrollment template, bounded at 30 embeddings per identity. On CFP-FP and IJB-C benchmarks, GSE closes the side-view gap by +23 points at 45° yaw and boosts TAR@FAR=0.001 by +9.4 points, all at CPU-level cost. No retraining. No GPU. Just a gallery that grows smarter every time it meets you.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Gallery Self-Evolution 框架：测试时用 dedup-FIFO 策展把识别成功的新视角样本写入 gallery，锁定注册模板并限制每身份 30 条嵌入，在无梯度更新、CPU 级成本下缩小侧脸识别差距。
AI.relevance_reason: 其无梯度的测试时记忆策展与容量上限、模板锁定机制，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据缓存、状态写入与淘汰策略的借鉴；但人脸识别与多模态推理主线无直接联系。
